rows.job_description:
AI Engineer




Who You Will Work With

The Consumer Products Center of Expertise collaborates with Bains global Consumer Products Practice leadership, client-facing Bain leadership and teams, and end clients on the development and delivery of Bain’s proprietary CP products and solutions.

These solutions aim to answer strategic questions relating to brand strategy (consumer needs, assortment, pricing, distribution), revenue growth management (pricing strategy, promotions, profit pools, trade terms), negotiation strategy with key retailers, optimization of COGS, etc.




You will work as part of the team in CP CoE comprising a mix of Directors, Managers, Project Leads, Associates, and Analysts working to implement cloud-based end-to-end advanced analytics solutions.

Delivery models on projects vary from working as part of a CP Center of Expertise, broader global Bain case team within the CP ringfence, or within other industry CoEs such as FS, Retail, TMT, Energy, CME, etc., with BCN on a need basis.




About You

A Master’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; Bachelor’s candidates with relevant industry experience will also be considered.
4–6 years of experience in AI/ML engineering, software development, and building and deploying production AI systems.
Hands-on experience designing agentic AI systems and multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, or Azure AI Agent Service.
Experience developing LLM-powered applications and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines with vector databases and embedding-based retrieval.
Working knowledge of graph databases (Neo4j, Cypher) for knowledge graphs, entity modeling, and graph-based retrieval.
Proficiency in Python and building backend APIs (FastAPI/Django) to serve models and agents in production.
Hands-on experience deploying AI workloads on Azure (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure ML) and cloud deployment best practices.
Solid grasp of prompt engineering, model evaluation, guardrails, and responsible AI practices.
Experience with Docker, CI/CD, and Git for MLOps/LLMOps workflows.
Good to have: Exposure to PostgreSQL, Snowflake, and Azure resources such as Redis and Blob Storage.
Good to have: Prior exposure to consulting projects or the CP (Consumer Products) business domain.



What You’ll Do

Design, build, and deploy agentic AI systems and LLM-powered applications that automate complex analytical and business workflows for Consumer Products clients.
Develop and orchestrate multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, and Azure AI Agent Service, integrating tools, memory, and reasoning loops.
Build and optimize retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, combining vector search with Neo4j knowledge graphs and graph databases.
Model and query graph databases (Neo4j/Cypher) to represent complex entity relationships and power graph-based retrieval and reasoning.
Engineer, evaluate, and fine-tune prompts and LLMs, implementing guardrails, evaluation harnesses, and human-in-the-loop feedback for accuracy and safety.
Develop backend APIs and services (Python, FastAPI) to serve AI models and agents into production applications.
Deploy, scale, and operate AI workloads on Azure (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Kubernetes Service), optimizing for performance, cost, and reliability.
Build and maintain MLOps/LLMOps pipelines using Docker, CI/CD, and Git for continuous deployment and monitoring of AI services.
Implement observability, logging, and evaluation to monitor model quality, latency, and drift of agentic systems in production.
Collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and consulting teams to translate business problems into robust, scalable AI solutions.
The Senior Associate is expected to have a knack for seeking out challenging problems and producing their own ideas, which they will be encouraged to brainstorm with their peers and managers.
They should be willing to learn new techniques and be open to solving problems with an interdisciplinary approach.
They must have excellent coding skills and should demonstrate a willingness to write modular, reusable, and functional code.



What Makes Us a Great Place to Work

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity, and a model of social responsibility.

We are currently ranked the #1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years.

We believe that diversity, inclusion, and collaboration are key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities, and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally.

We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor, and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ, and parents.

Greetings from VLink India Pvt Ltd!




We are currently hiring for a AI Engineer role with VLink India Pvt. Ltd. based in Gurugram, supporting our client BlackRock. .




Please find the requirements below:

4+ years of professional experience in software/application development, with strong exposure to Agentic AI / Generative AI.
Hands-on experience in Agentic AI development is mandatory, including AI agents, agent workflows, orchestration, tool/function calling, memory, or multi-step reasoning.
Strong experience working with LLMs and GenAI technologies to build, integrate, deploy, or enhance AI-powered applications.
Experience with Agentic AI frameworks/tools such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or similar technologies.
Understanding of RAG, vector databases, embeddings, prompt engineering, tool calling, and AI application integration.
Experience developing or integrating AI agents with APIs, enterprise systems, databases, developer tools, or business applications.
Strong understanding of backend development, REST APIs, microservices, and scalable application architecture.
Java exposure is required, with good understanding of Core Java and backend application development.
Familiarity with Java concepts such as collections, exception handling, multithreading/concurrency, JVM fundamentals, and application debugging.
Hands-on experience with Java application deployment is preferred/required depending on project needs.
Experience deploying GenAI/Agentic AI applications or services in enterprise environments is an advantage.
Exposure to AI infrastructure, platform engineering, developer tooling, or AI transformation platforms is preferred.
Knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, or modern software development practices.
Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP is preferred.
Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Good verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work with cross-functional engineering and product teams.

Job Description: We are seeking a skilled AI Engineer with 2-4 years of experience to design, develop, and deploy AI/ML solutions, with a strong emphasis on Generative AI, NLP, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Time Series Forecasting. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with LangGraph and other Generative AI frameworks to build cutting-edge AI applications.
Key Responsibilities:
Develop and deploy AI/ML models with a focus on NLP, Generative AI, RAG, and Time Series Forecasting workflows.
Engineer and refine prompts to optimize performance for large language models (LLMs) and generative AI applications.
Implement and maintain data preprocessing pipelines, including data cleansing, feature engineering, embedding generation, and transformation for time series data.
Develop end-to-end solutions integrating LLMs with VectorDB (e.g., Weaviate, Pinecone, FAISS) for document retrieval, semantic search, and contextual query answering.
Utilize LangGraph and other Generative AI frameworks to build structured workflows for LLM-based applications.
Train and fine-tune machine learning models, including LLMs, to optimize performance for various use cases.
Analyze and interpret complex datasets, including time series data, ensuring scalable and efficient AI model deployment.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI/ML models into existing systems and workflows.
Ensure models are robust, scalable, and adhere to best practices in ethical AI development.
Conduct testing, performance benchmarking, and iterative refinements of AI models and pipelines.
Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI/ML, NLP, and cloud technologies and recommend integration strategies for emerging tools and techniques.
Create technical documentation and presentations to effectively communicate AI concepts to stakeholders.
Key Skills and Qualifications:
Required Skills:
AI/ML Expertise: Proven experience in developing, fine-tuning, and deploying AI/ML models, focusing on NLP, Generative AI, and Time Series Forecasting.
Prompt Engineering: Proficiency in designing, testing, and optimizing prompts for LLMs.
Data Analysis: Strong ability to process and interpret large and complex datasets, including time series data, for AI model training and validation.
Programming: Proficiency in Python and experience with AI/ML frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, and scikit-learn.
NLP Techniques: Understanding of tokenization, embeddings, transformer-based models (e.g., BERT, GPT, LLaMA), and RAG workflows.
Vector Databases: Experience with Weaviate, Pinecone, FAISS, or similar VectorDBs for document retrieval and storage.
LangGraph & GenAI Frameworks: Hands-on experience with LangGraph, LangChain, HuggingFace Transformers, OpenAI API, and other Generative AI tools.
Cloud Deployment: Familiarity with deploying AI solutions on AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Time Series Forecasting: Experience with ARIMA, LSTM, Prophet, and other forecasting techniques.
Model Training & Fine-Tuning: Ability to train and fine-tune machine learning models, including large language models (LLMs), to enhance performance and accuracy.
Problem-Solving & Collaboration: Strong analytical, problem-solving, and teamwork skills to work effectively in a cross-functional environment.
Preferred Skills:
Experience in implementing RAG workflows and integrating generative AI with retrieval-based systems.
Familiarity with ethical AI principles and compliance frameworks.
Knowledge of additional programming languages such as JavaScript or SQL.
Proficiency in MLOps practices for automating AI/ML pipelines and lifecycle management.
Experience in developing AI-driven applications for real-world industry use cases.
